unit_cn: Unit 1 Knowing Me, Knowing You 了解你我
source: 外研社(新标准)必修第三册 Unit 1 词表(p114 真词);IPA 标准词典英音回填;例句原创、人际关系/情感主题、含目标词、不超纲;多义词给多个中文释义。

words.example_en: She was in agony after her best friend let her down.
words.example_cn: 好友辜负了她之后,她痛苦极了。

words.meaning_cn: (报刊的)知心姐姐,情感专栏作者
words.example_en: Ben wrote to an agony aunt for advice about his friendship problem.
words.example_cn: 本写信向知心姐姐请教他的友谊问题。

words.example_en: When a friend is in trouble, we should be ready to help out.
words.example_cn: 朋友有难时,我们应随时准备帮一把。

words.example_en: He felt the team had been let down by one careless player.
words.example_cn: 他觉得整个球队被一名粗心的队员辜负了。

words.example_en: When we hold in anger, the pressure builds up like steam.
words.example_cn: 当我们压住怒火,压力会像蒸汽一样积聚。

words.example_en: I was only letting off steam when I complained about my teammate.
words.example_cn: 我抱怨队友只是在发泄情绪。

words.meaning_cn: 松的;不加约束的;随意的
words.example_en: A loose word said in anger can hurt a friendship badly.
words.example_cn: 气头上随口说的一句话会严重伤害友谊。

words.example_en: There is an old saying that loose lips can sink a friendship.
words.example_cn: 有句老话说,口无遮拦会毁掉一段友谊。

words.example_en: Careless words can sink a friendship just as they sink a ship.
words.example_cn: 不慎的言语会像弄沉船只一样毁掉友谊。

words.example_en: Remember that loose lips sink ships, so be careful what you share.
words.example_cn: 记住祸从口出,所以分享时要小心。

words.example_en: Instead of blaming others, he admitted that it was his own fault.
words.example_cn: 他没有责怪别人,而是承认那是自己的过错。

words.example_en: Honest communication is the best way to resolve a conflict with a friend.
words.example_cn: 坦诚沟通是解决与朋友冲突的最好办法。

words.example_en: Her strategy for keeping friends is to listen before she speaks.
words.example_cn: 她维系朋友的策略是先倾听再开口。

words.example_en: Saying nothing can sometimes send the wrong signal to your friends.
words.example_cn: 有时什么都不说反而会给朋友错误的信号。

words.example_en: Take a deep breath and calm down before you say something you regret.
words.example_cn: 在说出会后悔的话之前,先深吸一口气冷静下来。

words.example_en: Take a breath, calm down, and remember to think first and speak later.
words.example_cn: 吸一口气,冷静下来,记住先思考后开口。

words.example_en: If a teammate is not pulling their weight, raise it with the coach politely.
words.example_cn: 如果有队友没尽到本分,礼貌地跟教练提出来。

words.example_en: She raised her concern about the problem in a polite and professional way.
words.example_cn: 她以礼貌而得体的方式提出了对这个问题的担忧。

words.example_en: I felt annoyed when my friend repeated my words to everyone.
words.example_cn: 朋友把我的话转告给所有人时,我感到很恼火。

words.example_en: It took him a while to adjust to his new classmates after moving.
words.example_cn: 搬来之后,他过了一阵子才适应新同学。

words.example_en: As a good friend, it is your duty to be honest and kind.
words.example_cn: 作为好朋友,诚实善良是你的责任。

words.example_en: Hurting his feelings was an accident, so I apologised at once.
words.example_cn: 伤了他的感情是个意外,所以我立刻道歉了。

words.example_en: She let out his secret by accident and felt terribly sorry.
words.example_cn: 她无意中说漏了他的秘密,感到非常抱歉。

words.example_en: Trust is the core value of any close friendship.
words.example_cn: 信任是任何亲密友谊的核心价值。

words.example_en: Clear communication helps to ensure that small problems do not grow.
words.example_cn: 清晰的沟通有助于确保小问题不会扩大。

words.example_en: Growing up means learning to deal with the complexity of human emotions.
words.example_cn: 成长意味着学会应对人类情感的复杂性。

words.example_en: It is not easy to forgive a friend who has let you down.
words.example_cn: 原谅一个让你失望的朋友并不容易。

words.example_en: Try not to criticise someone in front of others, as it causes embarrassment.
words.example_cn: 尽量不要当众批评别人,因为那会造成尴尬。

words.example_en: Telling a small lie to avoid embarrassment can still hurt trust.
words.example_cn: 为避免尴尬而撒个小谎仍会损害信任。

words.example_en: He invited me to watch a boxing match, but I politely said no.
words.example_cn: 他邀我看拳击比赛,但我礼貌地拒绝了。

words.example_en: Lies often leave us in a tangled web that is hard to escape.
words.example_cn: 谎言常让我们陷入难以脱身的纠结之网。

words.example_en: One small lie can grow into a tangled web of bigger ones.
words.example_cn: 一个小谎言会发展成更大谎言交织的复杂网络。

words.example_en: When we begin to deceive, we weave a web of lies around ourselves.
words.example_cn: 当我们开始欺骗,就在自己周围织起了一张谎言之网。

words.example_en: A white lie is still an attempt to deceive someone we care about.
words.example_cn: 善意的谎言仍是试图欺骗我们在乎的人。

words.example_en: Many people try to justify telling white lies to protect others.
words.example_cn: 许多人试图为说善意谎言辩护,说是为了保护别人。

words.example_en: A true friend gives you frank comments so that you can improve.
words.example_cn: 真正的朋友会给你坦率的意见,好让你进步。

words.example_en: She hid her tears and lied that her day had been fine.
words.example_cn: 她藏起眼泪,谎称这一天过得很好。

words.example_en: If you must choose between truth and a lie, never pick the latter.
words.example_cn: 如果必须在真话和谎言间选择,绝不要选后者。

words.example_en: He repeated my words; moreover, he made the whole situation worse.
words.example_cn: 他转述了我的话;而且,他还把整件事弄得更糟。

words.example_en: Being independent does not mean you never need your friends' help.
words.example_cn: 独立并不意味着你永远不需要朋友的帮助。

words.example_en: A small misunderstanding can slowly push two close friends apart.
words.example_cn: 一个小误会会慢慢把两个亲密的朋友推远。

words.example_en: As the proverb says, a good fence between neighbours keeps a friendly distance.
words.example_cn: 正如谚语所说,邻里之间一道好篱笆能保持友好的距离。

words.example_en: Clear communication is the best way to deal with a conflict between friends.
words.example_cn: 清晰的沟通是处理朋友间冲突的最好方式。

words.example_en: First, you should apologise to your teammate for your careless words.
words.example_cn: 首先,你应为自己不慎的言语向队友道歉。

words.example_en: Honesty is an important value, even when the truth is hard to say.
words.example_cn: 诚实是一种重要的品质,即使真相难以启齿。

words.example_en: Good communication means telling your friend honestly how you feel.
words.example_cn: 良好的沟通意味着诚实地告诉朋友你的感受。
